trap.label: particípio
trap.wrong: Having took on ten staff, the firm grew fast.
trap.right: Having taken on ten staff, the firm grew fast.
trap.why: Em português o particípio de “tomar” é regular. Em inglês, take é irregular: took (passado), taken (particípio).

opts: The firm took ten on staff.
The firm took on ten staff.
The firm on took ten staff.

fix.wrong: Having took on the case, she called the board.
fix.right: Having taken on the case, she called the board.

fix.wrong: The firm took in ten staff.
fix.right: The firm took on ten staff.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Having + pp: “After she took on the case, she called.”
rewrite.answer: Having taken on the case, she called.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com take on: “The firm hired ten staff.”
rewrite.answer: The firm took on ten staff.
